notes.title: Nero Burning ROM Update - 20220926
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33779150/954ec1ec18cec032561afca8837800254603fb22.png[/img]

We updated the following features with some bugfixes:
[list]
[*] 1:1 Disc Copy
[*] Burn ISO, Raspberry Pi OS to USB
[*] Rip NRG audio disc image to audio file
[*] CD text multi-language support
[/list]

The version is synced to the Nero Platinum Suite version, please enjoy it.
